data.name: Raqeebah
data.gender_notes: Raqeebah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raqeebah is derived from the Arabic word 'raqeeb' which means observer, guardian or protector. The name Raqeebah carries the meaning “Observer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Raqeebah usually hope their child will grow to embody observer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A Raqeebah embodies vigilance and responsibility, always watching over and caring for those around her.
data.etymology: Raqeebah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Observer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raqeebah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: رقيبة
in_arabic.meaning: حفظ کرنے والی ، نگہداشت کرنے والی ، مراقبہ کرنے والی
in_arabic.long_meaning: رقيبة کا مطلب ہے حفظ کرنے والی ، نگہداشت کرنے والی ، مراقبہ کرنے والی۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے 'محافظ' یا 'نگہبان'۔ اسلامی روایت میں ، یہ نام ان خوبصورت معانی کی وجہ سے مقبول ہے جو ایک فرد کی ذمہ داری اور محافظ کے کردار کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں۔ قرآن میں ، الفاظ 'رقيب' اور اس کے مشتقات مختلف سیاق و سباق میں استعمال ہوتے ہیں تاکہ کسی چیز کی نگہداشت یا نظارت پر زور دیا جائے۔

in_urdu.name: رقیبہ
in_urdu.meaning: حفظ کرنے والی، نگہداشت کرنے والی، مراقبہ کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رقیبہ نام کا مطلب ہے حفظ کرنے والی، نگہداشت کرنے والی، مراقبہ کرنے والی۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی 'ر-ق-ب' جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'محافظ' یا 'نگہبان'۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں، یہ نام اپنی خوبصورت معانی اور روحانی مفہوم کی وجہ سے مقبول ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام ان نسائی عطا کیے گئے ہیں جو محافظ، نگہداشت کرنے والی، یا روحانی محافظ کے کردار سے وابستہ ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रकीबा
in_hindi.meaning: संरक्षक, देखभाल करने वाली, निगरानी करने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: रकीबा नाम का अर्थ है संरक्षक, देखभाल करने वाली, निगरानी करने वाली। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से निकला है, जहां इसका अर्थ है 'रक्षक' या 'संरक्षक'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अपनी सुंदर अर्थ और आध्यात्मिक महत्व के कारण लोकप्रिय है। यह नाम उन स्त्रियों को दिया जाता है जो रक्षक, संरक्षक या आध्यात्मिक मार्गदर्शक की भूमिका से जुड़ी होती हैं।

in_pashto.name: رقيبه
in_pashto.long_meaning: رقيبه نوم مانا دے پروټګال، څېړونکې، ساتونکې. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخستل شوی دی چیرته چې د معنی لري 'محافظ' یا 'نگهبان' . په پښتني او افغان روايت کې، دا نوم د هغې ښکلي معاني او روحاني مفهوم له امله مشهور دی. دا نوم هغو ښځو ته ورکړل شوی دی چې د محافظ، ساتونکې یا روحاني محافظ د رول سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Raqeebah
in_english.meaning: one who preserves, guards, or watches over
in_english.long_meaning: Raqeebah is derived from the Arabic root 'R-Q-B', which means 'to preserve', 'to guard', or 'to watch over'. In Islamic tradition, the name Raqeebah signifies a person who is a guardian, protector, or overseer. The term 'Raqib' and its variants appear in the Quran in various contexts to emphasize vigilance, protection, and preservation. Historically, Raqeebah has been bestowed upon women embodying qualities of care, vigilance, and spiritual guardianship. The name symbolizes responsibility, protection, and a strong sense of duty.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: رقیبہ
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: رقيبه

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the concept of Raqeebah is deeply ingrained in various aspects of life. It represents the importance of being vigilant in one's duties and responsibilities towards oneself, one's family, and society at large. The phrase "Raqeeb bil Allah" which translates to "guardian in God's cause" is often used in Islamic literature to emphasize the significance of fulfilling one's role as a guardian or protector.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Raqeebah holds great significance in the Islamic faith. It is a reminder of the presence and constant watchfulness of Allah (God). The Quran states, "And we have not neglected in the Book a single thing. It is a reminder to those who are Allah-conscious" (Quran 6:38). The name Raqeebah can be seen as an invitation to embrace one's role as a guardian of one's own soul and to remain ever mindful of Allah's presence and guidance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Raqeebah: The Watcher, one who remains vigilant in guarding the faith and morals, always aware and alert to prevent straying from the righteous path.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Raqeebah is mentioned in the book 'Kitab al-Aghani' as a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Raqeebah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The book 'Kitab al-Aghani' is a historical collection of poetry and stories about the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East and North Africa
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Raqeebah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
